source_scope: Working tree included with this evidence; source hashes use UTF-8 LF normalization.
severity: High / P0 before Fleet32 operational acceptance

intermediate.cause: New migration test passed interval strings instead of datetime.timedelta to asyncpg; fixture corrected and all 76 rerun.

mypy.import_analysis_limitation: Default imported-module analysis and standalone check of unchanged backend/database/redis_client.py each report union-attr on lines 50 and 51 in this local environment. Exact-source CI checked separately after push.

verification: Real disposable PostgreSQL non-owner/NOBYPASSRLS role, one-connection pool.
Global queued/recovery/cancel discovery performs real SQL; production grants explicitly tested.
Two-tenant completion, child admission, multiple heartbeats, tenant context after commit/rollback, no pooled LOCAL leak.
Scoped cancellation excludes foreign-tenant forged parent references.
Two executors claim 10 disjoint runs each; 12 of 32 stay queued.
Committed first tenant is registered even when the next tenant commit fails.
Wrong tenant with known owner/generation cannot adopt or renew a run.
Separate non-owner OS process is killed after child admission, then replaced; original child ID retained.
Missing EXECUTE fails closed; granting access restores next poll without replacing executor.
Migration predicates, bounded 64 IDs, PUBLIC ACL revoke, invalid/null inputs and rollback-safe downgrade/re-upgrade.
limitations: No Android delivery in these tests: child terminal results and accelerated lease expiry are SQL fixture writes.
Global discovery is filtered to fixture tenant IDs after real lookup in tests; subprocess probe is tenant-scoped.
Backend/APK pilot not deployed; old Docker projects untouched.
Other workers, nested capacity, global/per-device quota, fairness and native runtime-role canary remain open.
No 32/64-device benchmark, full network/SQL/Redis fault matrix, or eight-hour pass.
Raw logs and credentials retained privately; CI results belong only to their exact head SHA.
